Lily hopes to visit Tokyo one day. Last Thursday, Lily and Max went to the temple fair. Lily and Max had great fun there. As an only child, he learned to play alone.

It takes twenty minutes to get to the temple fair by bike. The temple fair is one of the best places in the city. Lily thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. Also, grandma cooks dinner for us.
Lily borrowed a book about music from the supermarket. Lily wants to be a cook in the future. Lily learned a lot about music. My uncle moved to Mexico City for work last year.
Max is interested in swimming. Lily spent the weekend at the supermarket. They took many photos at the dragon boat river.
